lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly, and exempt from prConcurrentLimit: only lockfile maintenance moves transitive versions, and osv-scanner findings are almost always transitive. See docs/ci-security.md.

packageRules.description: Group non-major devDependency bumps into one PR
Runtime dependencies stay individual PRs — the app ships them
Security overrides get their own PR: each one exists for a named advisory and must not go stale inside a grouped bump. See docs/ci-security.md.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: PR styling only. Detection comes from osvVulnerabilityAlerts: this option itself is GitHub-only (Renovate supportedPlatforms), and Dependabot is off on the mirror by design.
